Spend in proof-of-burn.Short Description of the Vulnerability: The Spend template uses AssertGreaterEqThan without explicit bit-length validation on the inputs. This allows a malicious prover to provide inputs that exceed the expected bit range, causing the comparison to yield incorrect results. An attacker could create a proof where the balance is incorrectly verified against the withdrawn amount plus fee.
Spend in proof-of-burn.Short Description of the Exploit: A malicious prover can craft inputs where balance appears less than withdrawnBalance + fee in the field, bypassing the assertion check through circomlib's overflow behavior in comparison templates.
Spend in proof-of-burn.Proposed Mitigation: Add explicit range checks using Num2Bits to validate that all inputs (balance, withdrawnBalance, fee) remain within expected bit lengths before performing comparisons.
